item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Encryption at rest with customer-managed keys in Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now supports customer-managed keys (CMK) for encryption at rest in public preview. The service previously used only service-managed keys (SMK) by default.

  • Source: Azure Updates
